verdict.rationale: The CLI documents a `skills init [name]` command that creates a new SKILL.md template (e.g. `npx skills init my-skill`). The Agent Skills spec says SKILL.md must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown, says agents load each skill's name and description, and documents optional fields plus a `skills-ref validate` check. Missing for 10: evidence of what the generated template actually contains, an explicit spec quote making name/description required fields, and hands-on or independent confirmation that `skills init` works.
